title: Momcozy Baby Monitor BM01 Add-on Camera Unit, 1080P HD Resolution
bullets: 【Easy to set up, connect up to 4 cameras】- It only takes 5 seconds to pair the additional camera unit with the Momcozy baby monitor BM01 (B0BG83KWQT), and up to 4 camera units can be connected at a time. Meet your needs to take care of multiple children, and can be placed in different rooms so as not to miss any activities of the baby.
【Split screen display】- When two or more cameras are connected, Video feeds shown on the screen switch automatically every 10 seconds to cover multiple rooms.

【1080P Full HD Resolution】With the 1080p HD camera, you can see the details of the picture more clearly, whether it is day or night. At the same time, the 2x to 4x zoom function of the momcozy baby monitor allows you to observe your baby up close.
【Easy Pairing】It only takes a few simple steps to achieve pairing, which is convenient and fast.
